scientific_choices.choice: Paper section3.5/Algorithm2 uses confidence-threshold full-image DeepSolo fallback; CLIP is a separate experimental extension.

Reuse frozen B16/PARSeq minimum scores, TRAIN80 CDF references, exact epoch61 crops and audited per-engine metrics. Keep DeepSolo instance score .4 fixed while varying only the image acceptance threshold.

Descriptive threshold grid and exact observed score breakpoints. TEST curves inspect labels for reporting, not for selecting a new threshold or claiming an independent selected-threshold result. TRAIN125 and TEST300 remain separate.

Count care PARSeq words retained separately from final care words after complete-image replacement. Preserve raw/ignored counts, TP/FP/FN, detected-word precision, TN0 accuracy, recall and F1. Missing fallback outputs invalidate the entire point, without omitted images or substituted outputs.

Threshold recombination uses CPU only and no new main-model inference. Optional missing TRAIN DeepSolo outputs use the existing qualified isolated single-image FP32 CUDA subprocess with original runtime/memory/error receipts.

Initially only63 TRAIN DeepSolo outputs exist; high thresholds need further predictions. Each unavailable full-population metric remains null until execution. Existing paper artifact/metric and approximate polygon-ignore ambiguities remain unchanged.
